title: CLOSINGBALANCEMONTH is BLANK when the last date of the month has no data
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", CLOSINGBALANCEMONTH ( [Sales], 'Date'[Date] ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 3, 1 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 3, 31 ) )

source.quote: It does not search for the last date that has data.
source.supports: no row on the last day gives BLANK
the definition: the expression on the last date of the month

derivation: The last date of March 2024 is the 31st, which has no sales (the only March sale is on the 10th), so the result is BLANK.
notes: The type of the BLANK column is not asserted.
